note: Lint patterns for English report text. `\b` is rewritten to a Unicode-aware word boundary. scope: all = every text field; prose = everything except the fix block; notDevNote = everything except fix.dev_note; cause = the 'why it happens' field; title = titles. Quoted on-screen text and URLs are removed before matching.

rules.pattern: \b(compliant|compliance|conformant|conforms|conformance|certified|certification|accredited|fully accessible|100\s?% accessible|accessible to everyone|accessible for everyone|(meets|passes|satisfies) (all )?(of )?wcag|wcag[- ](approved|validated)|ada[- ]compliant|no accessibility (issues|problems|barriers)|guarantee[ds]?|lawsuit-proof|legally safe)\b
rules.message: Claims of conformance, certification or guarantees are forbidden; describe what was found.
No legal or fear language in generated text; the template carries the one approved legal sentence.
Describe the thing, not the people who built it.

rules.pattern: \b(suffer\w*|afflicted|victims?|wheelchair-bound|confined to|handicapped|crippled?|deaf-mute|deaf and dumb|retarded|special needs|differently abled|\w+ly challenged|able-bodied|normal (users?|people)|healthy (users?|people)|the (blind|deaf|disabled)|epileptics?|the elderly)\b
rules.message: Use the fixed group labels and respectful wording.

rules.pattern: \b(make sure|should|must|needs? to|have to (fix|add|change|update)|consider|we recommend|it is recommended|recommended|we suggest|we advise|is required to)\b
rules.message: No fix wording outside the --fix block.
No code, tags, attributes, technique or internal IDs in client text.

rules.pattern: (\b(undefined|NaN|null|TODO|TBD|FIXME|lorem ipsum)\b|\[object Object\]|\bas an AI\b|\bas a language model\b|\uFFFD|\{\{|\}\})

\b(it is (important|worth) (to note|noting)|it should be noted|please note|note that|in order to|due to the fact|a number of|in terms of|with regard to|basically|essentially|actually|very|really|various|additionally|furthermore|moreover|in conclusion|overall,)\b

rules.message: Minimising words make the reader feel slow; cut them.
Let the consequence show severity, not adjectives.
Sounds like tool output; name the real thing.

rules.pattern: (cannot access (the )?content|may have difficult\w*|negatively impact\w*|poor (user )?experience|affects accessibility|accessibility issues?|inclusive experience|is affected)
rules.message: Vague impact: say what the person experiences.
Passive constructions in the cause can read as blame; say what the thing is built as.
The report holds only this review's findings: never name or refer to other tools, scanners or reports.
